product: OCO-2 · XCO₂, column average (NASA GIBS OCO-2_Carbon_Dioxide_Total_Column_Average layer, annual cell mean)
processing: XCO₂ recovered from the daily image using the official GIBS palette (0.4 ppm bins): 13105886 soundings across 3814 days. Annual mean per 2° cell = mean of its monthly means; a month requires 3 or more soundings and a year requires 6 or more months. Soundings outside the palette range (below 380 ppm or 480 ppm and above), discarded: 0. Pixels with an off-palette color, discarded: 202.
citation: OCO-2 Level 2 bias-corrected XCO2 and other select fields from the full-physics retrieval aggregated as daily files, Retrospective processing V11.2r (OCO2_L2_Lite_FP). NASA GES DISC, concept id C2912085112-GES_DISC. Imagery served by NASA Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), ESDIS.
